description:
Supervised donor-held-out transfer from expression to cortical layers. Genes are already the 500 outer-training variance-selected non-mitochondrial features and have identical order in train/test. Pipeline:
- Per-gene z-score using only training data (mean/std). No test-fit or any neighbor/batch adaptation; fixed per-row computation only arises from this linear transform.
- Multinomial Logistic Regression (solver=saga, L2) with deterministic seed. Sample weights balance both class imbalance and donor imbalance: weight = class_weight(y) * group_weight(donor), where each donor contributes equally and classes are inversely proportional to their training frequency. This also makes the CV robust to folds missing some classes.
- Hyperparameter C is chosen by GroupKFold over donors (2 folds). For each fold, the scaler is refit on the fold’s training split only; macro-F1 across all seven labels [0..6] with zero_division=0 is averaged across folds. Missing classes in a fold are handled naturally (no training samples → no weights for that class; evaluation still includes all 7 labels).
- Final model is retrained on all training donors with the chosen C and the training-only scaler, then predicts argmax labels for the test spots.
The method uses only expression, respects grouped validation by donor, avoids any test-driven selection/normalization, and outputs one integer label 0..6 per test row.
